name: Soyuz TM-10
about: Soyuz TM-10 (1990-067A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1990 Aug  1. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1990 Sep  3), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
